dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 27, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Rangers Dominate Mariners in Texas, Lindor Shines in Mets Rout**

Kumar Rocker delivered a strong outing for the Texas Rangers, going 6.2 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. On the other side, Randy Arozarena and Joc Pederson both had strong games for Seattle, but it wasn't enough as the Rangers took a 7-3 win. Meanwhile, Francisco Lindor continued his hot streak with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 6 RBIs in the New York Mets' 14-3 blowout of the Atlanta Braves.
